info.title: API.SH: Trade Me
info.description: The Trade Me API from API.SH: public Trade Me data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Trade Me's categories (or one branch): number (what the search takes as `category`), name, path, link, live listing count, leaf, classifieds and restricted flags and the sub-categories down to the depth asked.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-categories

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: One branch, e.g. 0001- (Motors) or 0001-0268- (Cars). Default: the whole tree.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Job listings on Trade Me Jobs with keyword, category, region, district, job type, pay type, pay range, employer and sort: id, link, title, company, category, region, district, location, job type, contract length, pay, listed and closing dates, reference, work permit flag, summary, bullet points, agency and logo. With `id`: one job with its full description. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-jobs

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One job: its listing number or link (returns the full description).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region number as in Trade Me links.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District number as in Trade Me links.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Only jobs listed by this member (an employer or agency).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Trade Me listing: prices, bids, reserve, dates, views and watchers, description, attributes, photos, shipping and payment options, public questions and answers and, for business sellers, the member and store (name, description, logo, feedback). Pass `id`, `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Trade Me listing questions and answers
get.description:
Every public question asked on an open Trade Me listing and the seller's answer: question, date asked, asker's nickname, answer, date answered and whether it is a seller comment. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-listing-questions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A listing number or link (open listings).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
New Zealand vehicle listings with make, model, condition, region, body style, fuel type, transmission, year, price, odometer, engine size, seats and seller type filters and sort: make, model, year, odometer, price, body style, fuel, transmission, engine size, colour, owners, location and photos, paged. Pass `id` or `url` (or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result) for one listing with the full description, all attributes, photos and, for dealers, the dealer. Private sellers' details are never returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-motors

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: new, used, classic, exdemo or certifiedpreowned.

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Convertible, Coupe, Hatchback, Sedan, StationWagon, Suv, Ute, Van or People Mover.

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: Petrol, Diesel, Hybrid, Plug-in hybrid, Electric or LPG.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1); `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: open the first current result of a search made with these params instead of an id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
New Zealand real-estate listings, for sale or to rent, with region, district, suburb, property type, bedrooms, bathrooms, price, floor area and land area filters and sort: price, address, bedrooms, bathrooms, floor and land area, parking, location, agency, open homes and photos, paged. Pass `id` or `url` (or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result) for one listing with the full description, attributes, photos, video, nearby recent sales and agency with its agents.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-property

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: House, Apartment, Townhouse, Section, Dwelling, BareLand, Unit or Studio.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (NZD; per week for rentals).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (NZD; per week for rentals).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1); `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: open the first current result of a search made with these params instead of an id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Trade Me (New Zealand) marketplace listings for a keyword with category, region, district, condition, price, buy-now, clearance, free shipping, a seller's member id and sort: titles, buy-now and start prices, bids, reserve state, dates, region and suburb, photos and tags. `categories`, `filters` and `sort_options` list what the site offers for the search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-search

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region id (2 Auckland, 12 Wellington, 16 Canterbury; see `filters`).

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Only this seller's listings (a business seller's member id from a listing).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Other site filters as name:value (names from `filters`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Trade Me member profile and listings
get.description:
A Trade Me member's public profile (nickname, first name, occupation, biography, photo, suburb, join date, address verified and authenticated flags, last login), their feedback (positive, neutral, negative and unique counts, recent feedback) and their current listings. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trademe-seller

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: A member id (as `member_id` in job or search results) or a link with ?member_listing=<id>.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
